thesis: Netflix has strong current profitability and free cash flow, and its forward P/E is below its trailing P/E. The debate remains unresolved because the growth assumption is not evidenced in Layer 1 and the stock is still below the 200-day SMA without a dated catalyst.
strongest_counterexample: The market may already be discounting the damaged technical picture: if earnings growth and cash generation continue, the 20.9x forward P/E and improving short-term momentum could support a re-rating before the 200-day average is reclaimed.
invalidation_conditions: Price reclaims and sustains above the 200-day SMA near $87.84 with volume at or above its 20-day average
Reported revenue and free-cash-flow growth materially accelerate without operating margin falling below 28%
Reported revenue growth decelerates materially or operating margin falls below 25%, invalidating the constructive fundamental case
evidence_gaps: No dated news or dated analyst recommendation evidence
No dated revenue, subscriber, advertising, content-cost, or management-guidance trend
No evidence establishing the future Fed path or USD/MYR trend
decisive_factors: 29.5% operating margin, 24.3% net margin, and $9.46B free cash flow
Forward P/E of 20.9x versus trailing P/E of 25.1x
Price above the 20- and 50-day averages with positive MACD
Price remains below the $87.84 200-day SMA and sentiment evidence is unavailable
